boxes.meaning: to, until, up to a place or time

english.note: Use 到 for contact or an endpoint, a resulting state or effect, a degree reached, and the upper end of a range.
This is the all-purpose choice for marking the endpoint of a time period or a place in everyday Cantonese.
Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese equivalent for reaching an endpoint in time.

examples.english: I stopped when I got to the doorway.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 dou3 mun4 hau2 zau6 ting4 dai1

examples.english: We will wait until six o’clock before leaving.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dang2 dou3 luk6 dim2 sin1 zau2

examples.english: I’ll stay till ten tonight before I leave.
examples.traditional: 我會留到夜晚十點先走。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 lau4 dou3 je6 maan5 sap6 dim2 sin1 zau2
